subtitle: A quiet corner for a short break.
backend.missing: This optional mode needs BetterDisplay running with command line integration enabled. Native mode needs no extra app.
corner.label: Trigger corner
restore.label: Restore brightness
language.label: Language
purpose: Taking a short break while your computer agent works? Use a corner to dim supported display output while keeping your session. SceneHush does not prevent sleep or guarantee continued agent tasks.
risk: Dimming is not locking. Anyone nearby may restore the screen and use your Mac. Lock your Mac when it is unattended or in a shared space.
system.conflict: This corner already has a macOS action
system.explanation: Replace its macOS Hot Corner action with SceneHush? The original setting will be saved so you can restore it in Settings.
system.restoreExplanation: Restore the macOS corner actions saved by SceneHush? SceneHush will be disabled to avoid conflicting actions.
error.config: Could not read or save settings. Check local file permissions.
error.dim: Could not dim the displays; saved state was restored where possible. Some displays may not support this method. Check the setup or try the other method.
error.restore: Some displays could not be restored. Reconnect them and choose Restore brightness now.
error.generic: The change could not be completed. Check the details below and try again.
method.label: Dimming method
native.explanation: Dims display output without a desktop overlay. Hardware brightness is unchanged. HDR, virtual displays and some drivers may be unsupported.
